Zero-skip counts refer to the local source and 72 real receiving tests, not an invented count for every hosted installed source case.

The clean public smoke covers Linux/Python 3.14 and controlled provider/prepared, portable/composition/evidence readers, CLI and dependency closure. Real scientific producer compatibility is bounded by the separate eight-cell pinned PyUnitWizard receiving gate.

No new Sabueso release or current-public Sabueso receiving matrix is certified here; its receiving owner retains that qualification.
